verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents the whole chain. Agent Checkouts start a checkout run from a product URL and spending cap, and Crossmint completes the checkout on the user's behalf. Agent Cards issue a scoped, one-time, network-verified order-intent credential so the agent never sees the real card. The checkout lifecycle is then polled to a terminal state. Caveats: there is no staging environment, so testing happens in production; v1 offers polling only, with no webhooks; and Visa card eligibility is limited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the confirmed-order/receipt payload for agent checkouts, a sandbox test environment, webhook-driven completion for agent checkouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
